% \let, \futurelet.
\def\show#1{\message{[\meaning#1]}}
\futurelet\a\show\b\show\a
\futurelet\a\show{}\show\a
\def\look{\futurelet\next\report}\def\report{\message{\meaning\next}}
\look\par\look\relax\look{}\look\message{m}
\let\c=\relax\show\c \let\d\par\show\d \let\e= x\show\e \let\f=\undefinedthing\show\f
\def\g{G}\let\h\g\show\h \def\g{H}\show\h
\let\i=  =\show\i
\def\:{\let\spacetoken= } \: \show\spacetoken
\let\j\spacetoken\relax\show\j
